mapper.select: select D.dept_no, D.dept_name, D.dept_info, count(E.emp_no) member_count from dept D left outer join emp E on D.dept_no = E.emp_dept_no and E.emp_state = 'active' where D.dept_block = 'Y' group by D.dept_no, D.dept_name, D.dept_info order by D.dept_no asc

select D.dept_no, D.dept_name, D.dept_info, count(E.emp_no) member_count from dept D left outer join emp E on D.dept_no = E.emp_dept_no and E.emp_state = 'active' where D.dept_no = #{deptNo} and D.dept_block = 'Y' group by D.dept_no, D.dept_name, D.dept_info

select E.emp_no, E.emp_name, E.emp_email, E.emp_contact, P.position_name, E.emp_presence, E.emp_level, EP.attach_no from emp E join position P on E.emp_position_no = P.position_no left outer join emp_profile EP on E.emp_no = EP.emp_no where E.emp_dept_no = #{deptNo} and E.emp_state = 'active' order by P.position_no asc, E.emp_name asc
